name: Sega Tsubame
source:
A girl from the Kansai region with a booming and characteristic Kansai accent. Tsubame's mother passed on when she was young, and because of it her father became a gambler. Tsubame has been affected by having a gambler father, as a result she became one herself. Since she can remember herself, Tsubame's dream has been of gambling  to follow her father to Las Vegas. Aiming to realize her dream, she spends all her time in gambling business day and night. She also is extremely reluctant to rely on people. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3560]Getchu[/url].]
